question: The Atal Tunnel has been built by which organisation?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Border Roads Organisation__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Border Roads Organisation:**

 
 
• The tunnel has been named after a former Indian Prime Minister, Atal Bihari Vajpayee.
 
• It is constructed by Border Roads Organisation (BRO).__
 
• It connects Manali to Lahaul Spiti valley through the 9.02 km tunnel, located at an altitude of 3000 meters.
 
• It has a semi-transverse ventilation system.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **__Important Points__**

__
 
• The Atal Tunnel in Rohtang, Himachal Pradesh, India is the World’s longest highway tunnel. 
 
• It is constructed at an altitude of 3000 meters and is about 9.02 kilometres long, connecting Solang Valley near Manali to Sissu in Lahaul and Spiti districts. 
 
• It was inaugurated by the Prime Minister, Mr. Narendra Modi on October 3, 2020, in the presence of Rajnath Singh (Minister of Defence), Jai Ram Thakur (CM of Himachal Pradesh), and Anurag Thakur (Minister of State for Finance).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Central Public Works Department:

 
 
• The Central Public Works Department of India commonly referred to as the CPWD, is a premier Central Government authority in charge of public sector works. 
 
• CPWD deals with buildings, roads, bridges, flyovers, complicated structures like stadiums, auditoriums, laboratories, bunkers, border fencing, border roads (hill roads), etc. 
 
• It is headed by the Director General (DG) who is also the Principal Technical Advisor to the Government of India.
 
 
 
• National Highways Authority of India:
 
 
• The National Highways Authority of India or NHAI is an autonomous agency of the Government of India.
 
• It was set up in 1995 and is responsible for the management of a network of over 50,000 km of National Highways out of 1,32,499 km in India. 
 
• It is a nodal agency of the Ministry of Road Transport and Highways.
 
 
 
• **State Public Works Department:**
 
 
• The State PWD is an agency of the State Government for Planning, Construction, maintenance, and repairs of all works and buildings financed from the Civil Works budget, Estate work at places.
